title: The Age of Crime: Why there is a call to lower juvenile age threshold following rise in crimes by minors in Keralam
description: Back-to-back incidents of heinous crimes involving juveniles have given rise to a public demand for amending the Juvenile Justice Act to lower the age threshold. Child rights campaigners, however, caution against lowering the age limit and say such changes shall be considered only after wide consultations. K.S. Sudhi takes a look at opposing view points.
